lines.raw: Nobody plans a delivery route for each address.

lines.raw: The SSF and Nepal's health insurance programme do something similar with hospital care: instead of pricing every possible operation separately, they group them into **package rates** (for example, one package for a normal delivery and another for a caesarean).
lines.say: The S S F and Nepal's health insurance programme do something similar with hospital care: instead of pricing every possible operation separately, they group them into package rates (for example, one package for a normal delivery and another for a caesarean).

lines.raw: The idea in one sentence.
lines.say: The idea in one sentence.

lines.raw: A **grouper** is software that reads the codes on a claim (diagnoses, procedures and a few patient details) and, following a fixed rulebook, puts the stay, visit or member into **one of a few hundred meaningful groups** that can be paid or compared.
lines.say: A grouper is software that reads the codes on a claim (diagnoses, procedures and a few patient details) and, following a fixed rulebook, puts the stay, visit or member into one of a few hundred meaningful groups that can be paid or compared.

lines.raw: The US version: too many codes to use one by one.
lines.say: The U S version: too many codes to use one by one.

scenes.section: The US version: too many codes to use one by one

lines.raw: In the US: Why the US needs groupers.
lines.say: In the U S: Why the U S needs groupers.

lines.raw: US claims use **ICD-10-CM** (International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision, Clinical Modification) for diagnoses: over **70,000** codes.
lines.say: U S claims use I C D 10-CM (International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision, Clinical Modification) for diagnoses: over 70,000 codes.

lines.raw: Hospital stays use **ICD-10-PCS** (Procedure Coding System) for procedures: over **75,000** codes.
lines.say: Hospital stays use I C D 10-PCS (Procedure Coding System) for procedures: over 75,000 codes.

lines.raw: Doctors and outpatient services use **CPT** (Current Procedural Terminology) and **HCPCS** (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) codes: over 10,000 more.
lines.say: Doctors and outpatient services use C P T (Current Procedural Terminology) and H C P C S (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) codes: over 10,000 more.

lines.raw: A payer cannot set a separate price for every possible combination, and an analyst cannot compare hospitals stay by stay.
lines.say: A payer cannot set a separate price for every possible combination, and an analyst cannot compare hospitals stay by stay.

lines.raw: Groups make both possible.
lines.say: Groups make both possible.

lines.raw: Two jobs for groupers.
lines.say: Two jobs for groupers.

lines.raw: Purpose. Payment groupers: Decide **how much** a provider is paid. Analytics groupers: Help analysts **understand** and compare care.
lines.say: Purpose. Payment groupers: Decide how much a provider is paid. Analytics groupers: Help analysts understand and compare care.

lines.raw: Examples. Payment groupers: DRGs for hospital stays, APCs for hospital outpatient care (lessons 3 and 4). Analytics groupers: Condition categories, chronic condition flags, episodes of care (lessons 5 to 7).
lines.say: Examples. Payment groupers: D R G's for hospital stays, A P C's for hospital outpatient care (lessons 3 and 4). Analytics groupers: Condition categories, chronic condition flags, episodes of care (lessons 5 to 7).

lines.raw: Who chooses which grouper and version. Payment groupers: The payer's rules or contract. Analytics groupers: The analyst or the analytics team.
lines.say: Who chooses which grouper and version. Payment groupers: The payer's rules or contract. Analytics groupers: The analyst or the analytics team.

lines.raw: What happens if it is wrong. Payment groupers: The provider is paid the wrong amount. Analytics groupers: A report is misleading.
lines.say: What happens if it is wrong. Payment groupers: The provider is paid the wrong amount. Analytics groupers: A report is misleading.

lines.raw: Why it matters for data.
lines.say: Why it matters for data.

lines.raw: Group codes are some of the most useful fields in claims data, because they turn messy code lists into categories you can count, compare and price.
lines.say: Group codes are some of the most useful fields in claims data, because they turn messy code lists into categories you can count, compare and price.

lines.raw: But a group is only as good as the codes fed into it: missing or wrong diagnoses give the wrong group.
lines.say: But a group is only as good as the codes fed into it: missing or wrong diagnoses give the wrong group.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: A grouper reads codes on a claim and assigns one of a manageable number of groups, following a fixed rulebook.
lines.say: A grouper reads codes on a claim and assigns one of a manageable number of groups, following a fixed rulebook.

lines.raw: Grouping is needed because there are tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes.
